author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
FBFX's head of paint Anadora Peralta walks Adam through her paint tests for painting the iconic blue fins of Wolverine's cowl for Marvel Studios' Deadpool & Wolverine! From different metallic textures to varied weathering patterns, these paint variants show the range of possibilities for the mask's final look on screen. 

How Wolverine's Costume Was Created: https://youtu.be/AkvNYMghruM
Adam Savage Learns How to Paint Battle Damaged Armor: https://youtu.be/sSAB0Is86KE
Wolverine costume made by FBFX. Learn more about FBFX’s work at https://www.fbfx.co.uk/

Shot by Josh Self and edited by Norman Chan
Music by Jinglepunks
Additional media courtesy FBFX and Marvel Studios
